title: ECGT Regulatory Factsheet & Seller Guidance
executive_summary: Empowering Consumers for Green Transition (ECGT) mandates verifiable eco-claims, prohibits unsubstantiated greenwashing, and introduces durability/repairability disclosures across all EU marketplaces.
core_prohibitions: Generic claims like 'green', 'eco-friendly', 'environmentally safe' without verified eco-label.
Climate neutral claims based on carbon offset schemes.
mandatory_disclosures: Harmonised Commercial Guarantee of Durability label.
Repairability score (1.0 to 10.0) for smartphones, tablets, laptops, appliances.
